mapper.select: SELECT TRIM(DATE_FORMAT(YIELD*100,99990.9999)) FROM ( SELECT PA.YIELD FROM FIN_CASH_CALC_RULE PA LEFT JOIN FIN_CASH_INFO FIN ON FIN.CASH_ID = PA.CASH_ID WHERE FIN.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId} AND FIN.CASH_TYPE_2 = #{rateType} AND PA.EFF_DATE <= STR_TO_DATE(#{tradeDate},'%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY PA.UPDATE_TIME DESC ) WHERE LIMIT = 1

SELECT CCY FROM ( SELECT FIN.CCY FROM PA_FIN_CASH_CALC_RULE PA LEFT JOIN FIN_CASH_INFO FIN ON FIN.CASH_ID = PA.CASH_ID WHERE FIN.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId} ORDER BY FIN.UPDATE_TIME DESC ) WHERE LIMIT = 1

SELECT T.CLOSE_PRICE FROM ( SELECT M.CLOSE_PRICE FROM MST_EXCHARGE_QUOTE M
BASIS_CYY = #{basisCcy} AND TRADE_DATE < STR_TO_DATE(#{tradeDate},'%Y-%m-%d') AND QUOT_CYY = #{quotCcy} ORDER BY TRADE_DATE DESC
) T
LIMIT = 1

SELECT DISTINCT R.EFF_DATE effDate, R.BASIS basis, R.YIELD yield, FCPR.CALC_RULE calcRule, FCPR.FIRST_PAY_DATE firstPayDate FROM FIN_CASH_PLAN P LEFT JOIN FIN_CASH_CALC_RULE R ON P.CASH_ID = R.CASH_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_CASH_PAY_RULE FCPR on P.CASH_ID = FCPR.CASH_ID
AND P.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId}
AND R.EFF_DATE <= STR_TO_DATE(#{settleDate},'%Y-%m-%d')
ORDER BY R.EFF_DATE
